channelTitle: The same plant that flavors your beer was Grandma June's bedtime secret
hook: The same plant that flavors your favorite beer was actually Grandma June's bedtime secret.
remedy: As an old-fashioned home remedy, dried hops flowers, the very same ones used to flavor beer, were tucked into a small cloth pillow or steeped as a mild tea, valued as a gentle way to relax the mind and settle into sleep at the end of the day.
steps: Fill a small cloth sachet with a handful of dried hops flowers, or steep a teaspoon in hot water for 10 minutes as tea
Tuck the sachet inside your pillowcase, or sip the tea warm about half an hour before bed
Refresh the dried hops every few weeks once the smell fades
caution: Hops can have a mild hormone-like effect, so those with hormone-sensitive conditions should check with a doctor first. It can deepen drowsiness, so don't combine with alcohol or sleep medication.
cta: Did you know hops could help with sleep, or is this the first you're hearing of it? Let Grandma June know in the comments.
